title: Math-Grades-Go
descriptions: This project measures the effect of attending a Go class at a high school on school grades in mathematics. Grades have been recorded for every participant of the Go class in the three semesters before and after joining the Go activity. This allows to detect changes in the grades over time pointing to a potential effect of studying Go on math grades.
